note: Drying, re-wetting by rain, and damp rotting faster than dry over the same hours all derive. But the contamination drift in packages/core/src/matter/drift.ts uses damp = 0.4 + 0.6 * wetness / 5, so bone-dry meat still rots at 40% of full rate: strips are dry in 12 hours and at contamination 5 by 48 hours, eating them gives sickness 3.8, and the finished batch and the rained-on batch both end at 5. General rule: growth should need available water and fall to about nothing as wetness goes to 0 (S11: dried, salted, smoked act on S9's rate), so anything dried right through keeps.

needs: X5 join onto a body: a wrap with a strength set by care and haste, that lowers bleeding and loosens with movement
X1 move and exertion working a join loose
note: A glancing axe (steel, edge 3, effort 2) opens a wound of depth and bleeding 3.2, and bleeding costs health. Rule error in driftBody (packages/core/src/matter/drift.ts): health falls by bleeding * 0.02 per minute for ever and bleeding never lessens, so this walkable cut kills in about 80 minutes and a bleed of 0.5 kills in about 8 hours. General rule: bleeding should fall on its own at a rate set by depth (clotting), faster at rest and slower or reversed with exertion, so only deep wounds need closing. The bandage itself is unbuilt: coat refuses a body as target.

note: The core derives (also shown in examples.test.ts): the coat lights, a 0.3 second cut sears the edges and still bleeds. Rule error in surfaceReached (packages/core/src/matter/heat.ts): the surface approaches a flame at 1.2 per minute, so cloth against the burning blade for ten seconds stays unlit; held in an open flame, cloth needs between 1.5 and 2 minutes and dry tinder between 30 and 60 seconds. General rule: a surface in flame reaches ignition in seconds, scaled by flammability and wetness; bulk heating is what takes minutes.

needs: B5 intoxication on the body, read from P18 by ingest, adding up over doses

note: The vocabulary says ferment is S9, and the engine's only way to a fermented drink is the mash of food-09 left a month. Rule error in M4 (packages/core/src/matter/effective.ts): every contamination adds noxiousness 0.8 per level, so the month-old ferment has noxiousness 4 and one cup gives sickness 4 and costs 2 health, exactly as rotten meat would; potency stays 0 and ingest never reads it. General rule: what contamination turns into depends on what it grows in (sugary, watery, sealed gives potency and gas, not noxiousness), and ingest should pass P18 into B5 as a dose that accumulates. Separately, ingest replaces sickness only when a dose is larger than the present one, so repeated doses never add.
